# File Portal

> A two-machine document factory: drag-and-drop Windows portal widgets push files over a
> private Tailscale tailnet to a Linux receiver — no sudo, no open ports, no cloud relay —
> and a GPU conversion pipeline (Marker on an RTX 3080) turns dropped PDFs into an audited,
> deduplicated, git-versioned library. Single-operator, heavily self-documented: measured
> numbers name their numerator, denominator, and conditions; recorded claims are tagged
> Observed (re-measured) or Historical (transcribed).

Notes for agents:

- Start at the wiki index below; read at most two cited pages before acting.
- Two record surfaces are first-class: OPEN-TASKS.md answers "what was promised and never
  delivered"; SYMPTOM-INDEX.md answers "what is going wrong, its root cause, and where the
  guard lives". Read the relevant one before assuming.
- When a document and reality disagree, reality wins — measure, then fix the document.

## Docs

- [Wiki index](wiki/INDEX.md): Start here — the one-page map of the whole repo in reading order
- [README](README.md): What File Portal is, why it exists, layout, security model in brief
- [Manual](docs/20-file-portal-manual.md): The operator textbook — surfaces, levers, developer reference
- [Open task register](OPEN-TASKS.md): What has NOT been done — semantic vs mechanical, every line cited
- [Symptom index](SYMPTOM-INDEX.md): Retrieve by what the system is doing wrong — symptom, cause, guard
